question: does the product path reach the 0.8045 harness level when the full orchestration answer tier (SC three-vote + selector) is enabled?
instrument: same as the aligned parity probe (write_text seeding, product orchestrated retrieval top-24, harness generation prompt verbatim, official judge) but the answer path now runs the harness's own generate_answer: SC three votes (temperature 0.7) + context-grounded selector on multi-session.
findings: VERDICT: the 0.8045 fidelity target is NOT reachable on the current product write path, at any answer tier. Full orchestration moved the needle only 0.361 -> 0.376 (+1.5pp) against a -42pp gap.

The bottleneck is upstream of the answerer: on this seeding path (write_text extraction), retrieval summaries do not carry the answer-bearing text the harness's verbatim sessions carry. SC voting cannot vote up information that is not in the context.

This closes the fidelity acceptance with a definitive negative on the write_text product path, independent of answer tier. The harness 0.8045/0.894 numbers remain reproducible on the harness's own seeding (store.add verbatim), which is a different storage contract - exactly the gap ADR-013 Stage 2's raw layer exists to close, and the PG/store side now has it; the write_text path's extractor-rewrite step is the remaining loss point.
honest_reading: n=133 full pool, no sampling; one empty answer (1301 content filter, scored wrong). The comparison 0.376 vs 0.797 is same-pool same-judge same-answer-tier - the cleanest apples-to-apples reading this campaign has produced, and it is negative by a wide margin.
